config.killstats.title: KillStats Configuration
config.killstats.enabled.tooltip: Enable or disable the mod globally
config.killstats.hud_position.tooltip: Position of the HUD overlay on screen
config.killstats.hud_visible_always.tool: Show HUD even when not holding a weapon
config.killstats.hud_scale.tooltip: Scale of the HUD overlay (0.5 = half size, 2.0 = double size)
config.killstats.show_drop_value.tooltip: Show estimated drop value in Emeralds
config.killstats.show_session_summary.to: Show session summary in chat when leaving a world or resetting
config.killstats.pause_timer_in_menu.too: Pause the session timer when a screen is open (Escape menu, inventory, etc.)
config.killstats.persist_sessions.toolti: Save session data to disk so it persists across world leaves
config.killstats.play_milestone_sound.to: Play a sound when reaching a kill milestone
config.killstats.milestone_interval.tool: Chat notification every X total kills (0 = disabled)
config.killstats.custom_mob_ids.tooltip: Additional entity IDs to track (e.g. modid:mob_name)
killstats.hint.start: ⚔ KillStats — Press [%s] to start the session timer!
killstats.session.restored: ⚔ KillStats — Previous session restored! Press [%s] to continue
